remarks:
Who’s looking for an “Executive Ranch” on over one acre in Orchard Park with a view of the city lights?
Severyn Development presents our new “Taylor” model coming soon to Orchard Park. Check out this
2700 square foot ranch, with open kitchen with a huge island, cathedral ceiling living room, dining room
that can accommodate a 12 foot table and an adjoining 16’ by 18 ‘ sunroom. Primary suite is tucked
away with huge and elegant bathroom and gigantic walk in closet. Two other bedrooms and full bath are
located on the other side of the home. A welcoming foyer, private office, walk in pantry, and laundry
room complete the first floor. All Severyn homes are built to Energy Star standards.  Looking for a different plan or want to custom design your new home on this lot? This is a to be built home. This parcel is part of parcel TAX ID- 146089-154-170-0001-009-110 that will be sub divided once home is built.  Taxes will be determined once home is built.
